subject: Renewal: Request for tier smoothing and interim pricing safeguard
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha@heliohealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Cc: Mark Donovan <mark@heliohealth.com>
Date: Fri, 29 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal: Request for tier smoothing and interim pricing safeguard

Hi Rishi / Monica,

Hope you both are well. Our renewal with Redwood is coming up at the end of July and we're trying to lock in something that reduces volatility for our engineering org as usage ramps. We've seen an uneven month-to-month spike pattern in Q1-Q2 and want to avoid getting hit with overages while we finalize our forecasting tooling.

Ask: would Redwood consider a short-term "concierge smoothing" arrangement for the first 3 months of the new term that does two things:

- Hold current per-token pricing for up to a 30% month-over-month surge beyond our current commit for 90 days.
- Convert any usage above the commit in that window into a credit pool that can be applied to future months (rather than immediate invoiced overage).

We are open to a modest premium or a short-term commit uplift in exchange (e.g., 10% uplift on committed capacity for the quarter). Attached is our usage export for May/June to help the pricing discussion.

Can we get an initial proposal and a short call next week to align on guardrails? Ideally we'd have a formal proposal in the next 7–10 days so procurement has time to review.

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
Head of Platform
HelioHealth

Attachments: helio_usage_q1_q2_2026.csv (csv)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@heliohealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal: Request for tier smoothing and interim pricing safeguard

Samantha — thanks for the clear ask and the usage file. Nice to see HelioHealth scaling. We're sympathetic to the volatility problem and have a couple of ways to help without exposing either side to open-ended risk.

High level we can offer a "Concierge Smoothing Pilot":

- Pricing hold: maintain your current unit price for up to a 30% MOM surge for the first 90 days of the new term.
- Credit pool: any usage beyond that surge cap would be converted to a one-time credit equal to 50% of the overage value, applied to invoices across the following 6 months.
- Optional short-term uplift: a 12% commit uplift across your base tier for the same 90-day window (this unlocks a larger credit conversion rate of 70%).

Operational notes:
- We would require consumption reporting access and a weekly cadence for the pilot.
- We can limit the pilot to a specific model class (e.g., generation endpoints only) to reduce risk.

I'll loop in Laura from our pricing ops to create a draft term-sheet. Can you confirm if Mark from procurement needs to be on the kickoff call and what timezone works next week?

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Samantha — thanks for confirming a call. Per Rishi's note, attached is a short draft term sheet that lays out two tracks: one with the 12% short-term uplift and one without. Key bullets from the draft:

- Track A (with uplift): 12% commit uplift; 90-day price hold to current unit cost; overage -> credit at 70% conversion; weekly usage report and single-point ops contact.
- Track B (no uplift): no change to commit; 90-day price hold to current unit cost up to +30% MOM; overage -> credit at 50% conversion; bi-weekly usage review.
- Pilot limits: applies to generation and chat endpoints only; embeddings billed normally.
- Term: annual renewal with the pilot amortized into the first three invoice cycles; credits expire after 6 months.

Proposed next steps:
1) Quick 30-min call to confirm which track Helio prefers.
2) Redwood to produce a formal quote and DocuSign link within 48 hours of call.
3) Procurement review and signatures.

When would you and Mark be available next week? I'm available Tue/Thu afternoons Pacific.

Attachment: proposed-concierge-smoothing-term-sheet.pdf (pdf)

—Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Thanks Rishi and Monica — that looks reasonable and addresses our procurement concerns.

We'd like to proceed with Track A (with the 12% uplift). Mark and I are available Thu Jun 4 at 11:00 AM PT for the call. Please send the calendar invite and we'll be ready to sign the DocuSign after the call assuming ops validation goes well.

One ask for the term sheet: can you include explicit language that credits produced by the pilot are non-expiring within the 6-month window (i.e., cannot be clawed back unless there is documented abuse)? Procurement flagged that as needed language.

See you on Thursday — appreciate the flexibility.

Samantha Lee
